anomalies.observed: Both GND1 (pin 4) and GND2 (pin 5) of the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: GND1 (logic-side ground) and GND2 (isolated bus-side ground) should be on separate nets to maintain galvanic isolation, as required by the isolated CAN transceiver part and the specification's 'isolated CAN buses'.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in) ...
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The isolation between the logic side and the CAN bus side is defeated, so the CAN buses are not isolated. This can cause ground loops, loss of common-mode rejection, and potential damage, contrary to the intended design.

anomalies.observed: The /CAN0_N net includes J1.15 (HDMI SCL) and Module1.200 (HDMI0_SCL) in addition to the expected CAN0_N pins (U11.6, D10.1, R34.1, J2.8, J13.8).
anomalies.expected: J1.15 and Module1.200 should be on a separate HDMI0_SCL net, not connected to the CAN0_N bus.

evidence.quote: /CAN0_N : D10.1(Input,input) J1.15(SCL,passive) J13.8(Pin_8,passive) J2.8(Pin_8,passive) Module1.200(HDMI0_SCL,open_collector) R34.1(1,passive) U11.6(CANL,bidirectional)

anomalies.impact: The CAN0 bus is shorted to the HDMI DDC clock line, which will prevent both interfaces from functioning and may cause contention or damage.

anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23 (pins 2) and has no connection to any power source or driver.
anomalies.expected: The anodes should be connected to a 3.3V power source (e.g., +3V3 or a switched 3.3V rail) so the LEDs can operate.
anomalies.impact: The LEDs D4, D14, and D23 will never light because their anodes are floating.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies, most notably the isolated CAN transceivers have their logic and bus grounds tied together, defeating isolation, and the CAN0_N bus is shorted to the HDMI DDC clock. Additionally, the anodes of three status LEDs are left floating.
